message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies. The most famous signatures include:

| Signer | State |
|--------|-------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| George Washington | Virginia |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| John Jay | New York |
| James Madison | Virginia |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York |
| ... | ... |

(For a full list, you can refer to the official records or the National Archives.)
